# Plex

> > Plex is a free streaming platform offering movies, TV shows, and documentaries from classics like The Godfather to new releases like Toy Story 5 and Avatar: Fire and Ash.

Plex provides on-demand streaming content with curated collections, trending recommendations, and an extensive movie database spanning from 1920 to present. The platform features both popular blockbusters and independent films across multiple genres and languages.

## Key Topics

- Streaming movies and TV shows
- On-demand content
- Trending and discovery features
- Movie database (1920-present)
- Classic films (The Godfather, The 400 Blows)
- New releases (Toy Story 5, Avatar: Fire and Ash, Scream 7)
- Documentaries
- Actor filmographies
- Curated collections
- Expiring content alerts
- British television (The Prisoner)
- Coming-of-age films
- Independent cinema
- Free streaming

## Discovery and Trending

- [Trending - Plex](https://watch.plex.tv/discover): Main discovery page featuring trending movies like The Godfather
- [Trending - Plex (UK)](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/discover): UK trending page with Oscar nominees and upcoming films like Toy Story 5
- [Most Popular in the US - Plex](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/on-demand/list/trending): Trending movies and TV shows most popular with US viewers
- [Leaving Soon - Plex](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/on-demand/list/expiring): Collection of on-demand content expiring soon from Plex library

## Movie Database and Catalog

- [Movie Database from 1920 to Present - Plex](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/movie-database): Complete Plex movie catalog browsable by year from 1920 to present

## Featured Movies

- [Watch The 400 Blows (1959) Full Movie Free Online - Plex](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/movie/the-400-blows): Classic François Truffaut nouvelle vague film streaming free
- [Watch Panopticon (2025) Full Movie Online - Plex](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/movie/panopticon-2025): Georgian coming-of-age drama exploring sexuality and radicalization
- [Watch Castores. La invasión del fin del mundo (2015) Full Movie Free Online - Plex](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/movie/castores-la-invasion-del-fin-del-mundo): Documentary about Canadian beavers invading Tierra del Fuego
- [Watch Turkey: Fairy Chimneys and Underground Cities (2019) Full Movie Free Online - Plex](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/movie/turkey-fairy-chimneys-and-underground-cities): Travel documentary exploring Cappadocia's unique geological formations
- [MOTH (Man of the House) (2014) - Plex](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/movie/moth-man-of-the-house): British post-apocalyptic horror short directed by O-T Fagbenle
